push.title: W 2-0 vs They Dont Know | You: 8.0
push.body:
Good stuff, PhogsToffees. An 8.0 against They Dont Know. Not fireworks, but a nice warm campfire.

THE GOOD
+ 5 shots at They Dont Know's goal. Can't score 'em if you don't take 'em.
+ 9th straight match at 7.5 match rating. You can build a whole match on that.
+ Missed tackles 1, down from your usual 3. Little things like that are big things in disguise.
+ We got the W against They Dont Know, 2-0. Savor it.

THE BAD
- 72% passing (21 of 29). Repeat after me: With your back to goal, shield it and set it back to the runner facing play. Turning into traffic is a coin flip. Patience, partner.
- 3 of 5 shots on target. Let's try: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger. We'll drill it till it's dull.
- Tackles attempted 1, down from your usual 4. That's not a crisis, but it's a warning light.
- You and BellyTb1 both need a tune-up on shot selection. Do it together: cut it back to each other.
- Assists 0, down from your usual 1. That's the gap between a good night and a great one.

Skills corner: Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy.

PhogsToffees, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: The grass isn't greener on the other side; it's greener where you water it.

Today's lessons are tomorrow's strengths. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 2-0 vs They Dont Know | You: 7.5
push.body:
A 7.5, BellyTb1. Even the best barbecue gets a little charred sometimes.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at They Dont Know's goal. Shooting is believing, and you believed.
+ 1 key pass. Chance creation is generosity with a soccer ball.
+ Keep finding PhogsToffees; it's working like a charm.
+ 7th straight match at 7.5 match rating. More of that, please and thank you.
+ Best passes attempted of your 3 matches this session (26). That's the stuff I want framed.

THE BAD
- 1 of 4 shots on target. Small change, big gain: Hit the target first, beat the keeper second. A shot on target can still be saved into a rebound. We'll get there together.
- 65% passing (17 of 26, down from your usual 78%). Bread and butter: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
- shot selection showed up for you and PhogsToffees. Talk it through and cut it back to each other.
- 0.3 off your norm. Let it go like a bad haircut. It'll grow back.
- 2 tackles won took 0.1. Head up first, then play.

Back-garden drill: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.

Hey BellyTb1, hold onto this one: Be curious about your game, not cruel to it.

Hang in there; it's coming. - Coach Lasso
